name: Prepare a grant spending evidence pack
why: Builds the reconciled spending table and evidence gaps a funder report needs.

name: Grant spending evidence review assistant
why: Checks grant spending against the award rules and budget before a report goes in.

name: Grant restrictions cash reconciler
why: Splits bank cash into restricted grant money and free cash, so appeals never spend restricted funds twice.

name: Hand over a restricted fund program
why: Keeps a restricted fund's rules and open decisions intact when a project changes hands.

name: Honest appreciation note writer
why: Writes a thank-you with one true detail and no ask, the core of donor stewardship.

name: Prepare a useful customer newsletter issue
why: A starting point for supporter newsletters and impact updates with a pre-send checklist.

name: Plan an event follow up that earns a reply
why: Turns gala or open-day notes into follow-ups grouped by what each guest asked for.

name: Direct mail package reviewer
why: Checks a postal appeal's envelope line and letter before it prints.

name: Story email writer
why: Drafts story-led emails from one true story, useful for the lead-in and update emails of an appeal.

name: Build a volunteer induction checklist
why: Gets event and collection volunteers briefed on roles and rules before they fundraise.
